principle: Take the least powerful surface that can do the job: TweakXL data < redscript < CET Lua < ArchiveXL resources < RED4ext native code. Each step up is harder to verify and breaks more often on game patches.
always: cpforge index   (once per game version: vanilla API + TweakDB from your install)
look things up with cpforge api / cpforge tweak before writing; never write against a remembered name
cpforge check --compile, then cpforge package; test in game; cpforge logs

routes.title: Change game data (stats, prices, loot, vendors, item values, NPC records)
steps: cpforge tweak search <words> to find records
cpforge tweak show <Record> for its vanilla source
edit game/r6/tweaks/<Mod>/<Mod>.yaml
cpforge check (verifies $type, $base and references against tweakdb.bin)
avoid: REDmod .tweak overrides of whole vanilla files

routes.title: Change game behaviour or UI logic
steps: cpforge api search <name> and cpforge api class <Class> to read real signatures
prefer @wrapMethod over @replaceMethod
cpforge check --compile (hook targets + scc compile against your install)
avoid: @replaceMethod when a wrap works (it conflicts with every other mod touching that method)

routes.title: Add an in-game settings menu
steps: keep settings on a ScriptableSystem (created after Mod Settings loads)
register with ModSettings.RegisterListenerToClass(this)
avoid: storing settings on a ScriptableService (it is created before Mod Settings loads values)

routes.title: Lua tool, overlay window, console helper or hotkey
steps: registerForEvent('onInit'|'onDraw'|...)
registerHotkey(id, label, fn) for key binds
cpforge check (event names, Lua syntax when luajit/luac is on PATH)
avoid: file access outside the mod's own folder (CET blocks it)

routes.title: New item, clothing, weapon, vehicle, appearance, hair or texture
steps: edit resources in a WolvenKit project, keep them under source/archive/
cpforge build (WolvenKit CLI pack) into game/archive/pc/mod/<Mod>.archive
factories/localization in <Mod>.archive.xl, item records in r6/tweaks
cpforge check (the .xl paths must be inside the archive)
avoid: replacing vanilla resources when ArchiveXL can add new ones (replacers conflict)

routes.title: Native C++ plugin (RED4ext)
steps: cpforge new <Name> --kind red4ext
cpforge build (CMake + MSVC; the SDK is pinned to a commit that supports 2.5)
test in game; read red4ext/logs
avoid: native code for anything redscript or Codeware can already do
declaring runtime 2.31 on a 2.5 game (RED4ext refuses to load it)

routes.title: Custom key bindings and input contexts
steps: declare actions in game/r6/input/<Mod>.xml
listen with RegisterInputListener on the player (GameObject) and OnAction
avoid: hard-coded keys without a settings option

routes.title: Sounds, music, voice lines, ringtones
steps: put audio files and a manifest .yaml under game/r6/audioware/<Mod>/
play by event name from redscript
avoid: REDmod customSounds unless the mod must be REDmod-only

routes.title: Official REDmod package
steps: game/mods/<Mod>/info.json plus archives/, scripts/, tweaks/, customSounds/
users must deploy REDmod (launcher option)
avoid: REDmod script overrides of whole vanilla files when a redscript hook works

routes.title: Quests, NPCs, world edits, locations
steps: spawn with Codeware DynamicEntitySystem; tag spawned entities so you can clean them up
place pins with MappinSystem
world/sector edits through ArchiveXL streaming blocks and sector patches
avoid: leaving spawned entities alive across saves without cleanup

routes.title: A mod crashes, errors or stopped working (often after a game patch)
steps: cpforge logs (redscript, RED4ext, CET, ArchiveXL, TweakXL, Codeware, crash reports)
cpforge conflicts
for a mod you own: cpforge check --compile against the new patch; static check flags hook targets that no longer exist
avoid: blaming the first mod named in a log line before reading which mod's file the error points at

routes.title: Find which mods fight over the same thing
steps: cpforge conflicts --what scripts|archives|tweaks

routes.title: Package and publish a release
steps: cpforge bump patch|minor|major
write CHANGELOG.md
cpforge package (deterministic zip + validation + receipt)
cpforge nexus (page kit files to paste)
avoid: shipping CHANGELOG/STATE/dev files or API keys in the zip
